name: Toaru Gakko no Shota-sensei
original_name: とあるガッコの庶田先生
source:
Shota Daisuke works as a teacher at a certain school.
He's a pervert with a penchant for cute boys.
After ogling them is no longer enough to satisfy him,
he starts taking it even further...!
